scripts.audit: npm run bootstrap && npm run audit:run && npm run audit:render && npm run audit:open
scripts.audit:boulder:run: LLM_MODEL=gpt-4.1-nano BOOTSTRAP_IMPL=boulder node scripts/run.js --addresses .cre.addresses.json --rules cre/rules/rule.3643.json --output reports/boulder-results.json
scripts.audit:boulder: npm run abi:use:boulder && npm run bootstrap:boulder && npm run audit:boulder:run && npm run audit:boulder:render && npm run audit:boulder:open
scripts.audit:boulder:mutant:run: LLM_MODEL=gpt-4.1-nano BOOTSTRAP_IMPL=boulder BOULDER_MUTATION=token-audit-bug node scripts/run.js --addresses .cre.addresses.json --rules cre/rules/rule.3643.json --output reports/boulder-mutant-results.json
scripts.audit:boulder:mutant: npm run abi:use:boulder && npm run bootstrap:boulder:mutant && npm run audit:boulder:mutant:run && npm run audit:boulder:mutant:render

scripts.audit:matrix:compact: MATRIX_COMPACT=1 node scripts/audit-matrix.js && node scripts/render-matrix.js && open reports/matrix-report.html
